rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account, reviewed the user’s orders, and explained that returns require delivery while the order was still pending. The agent sought explicit confirmation before attempting to modify items and, after the tool wouldn’t support partial removal, asked for explicit confirmation to cancel the pending order. They executed the cancellation via the tool, and the tool confirmed refund of the full amount to the original payment method (PayPal). They then provided the exact refund amount when asked. All actions were performed on the authenticated user’s account and with appropriate confirmations. The only minor issue was stating a 5–7 business day refund timeline, which was not sourced from the tools; however, the core requirements—authentication, confirmation before writes, correct execution, and accurate final information—were met.
